name: cc-plugins
description: Anthony Baldwin's Claude Code plugins: a multi-row status line dashboard, status-driven terminal tinting, native desktop notifications, and a Discord channel.

plugins.name: statusline-dashboard
plugins.description: Opinionated multi-row status line: context, cost, rate-limit windows with pace balance, git/PR, sub-agents, and config-scope breakdowns. Zero-dependency Bun scripts with Nerd Font glyphs.

plugins.name: session-color
plugins.description: Tints the terminal background by session status — amber while Claude works, red when it needs you, green when it's done — per pane, so a wall of sessions reads at a glance. macOS, Linux (tmux-aware), Windows.

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude finishes or needs input, with elapsed time, a button that focuses the originating terminal tab/pane, an open-in-editor button, and an optional AFK webhook (Discord, Slack, ntfy, Gotify). Windows (WinRT) and macOS (UserNotifications).

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Discord channel for Claude Code — a messaging bridge with built-in access control (pairing codes, allowlists, per-channel opt-in). Fork of the official discord plugin, maintained as an improvement baseline.
